title: SpikeMba: Multi-Modal Spiking Saliency Mamba for Temporal Video Grounding

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Although Transformer models demonstrate advantages in capturing long-term dependencies, they tend to engage in uniform cross-modal interactions between every word and each video clip for each query.

problems.name: Uncertainty, Calibration, and Rejection
problems.evidence_sentence: Despite significant advancements, existing methods face challenges in managing confidence bias towards salient objects and capturing long-term dependencies in video sequences.
